scopePolicy: The collision boundary is every production Swift type whose name ends in an authority-shaped suffix (Renderer, Preparer, Evaluator, Director, Resolver, Policy, Reducer, Controller, Qualifier, Generator, Engine, Orchestrator, Coordinator, Balancer, Analyzer, Validator, Processor, Artifacts, or Preflight), every production Swift type ending in Profile, Preset, Mode, or Configuration, every static value whose identifier contains profile or preset, every bundled JSON resource under Sources, and every source path assigned to the semantic map's graph-effects-routing-and-mix component. The inventory classifies naming collisions and convergence; it does not infer authority from a suffix alone and does not replace executable data-flow tests.

authorityGroups.title: Canonical session director
authorityGroups.limitations: The director owns top-level score choice; delegated resolvers below remain bounded implementation stages under its immutable plan.

authorityGroups.title: Session-owned score resolvers and interest evidence
authorityGroups.limitations: These pure score helpers cannot dispatch a renderer or commit state independently of AutonomousSessionDirector.

authorityGroups.title: Session boundary and qualified-repeat policies
authorityGroups.limitations: The repeat decision selects exact accepted PCM or an already qualified bounded branch; it cannot plan or render a second phrase.

authorityGroups.title: Detached resolved-score motif evidence
authorityGroups.limitations: This bounded analyzer describes accepted resolved upper-score notes only in opt-in offline evidence; it owns no score choice, evaluator input, continuation, renderer, or future decision.

authorityGroups.title: Deterministic seed utility
authorityGroups.limitations: The Generator suffix is a lexical collision only; this value supplies deterministic entropy and owns no musical policy.

authorityGroups.title: Detached long-horizon session-trajectory evidence
authorityGroups.limitations: This bounded score-only observatory reports neutral segment, payoff, recovery, recurrence, and capability-exposure facts in opt-in offline evidence; it owns no score choice, PCM, evaluator input, continuation, renderer, or future decision.

authorityGroups.title: Canonical phrase-composition and kick-morphology owners
authorityGroups.limitations: Both are map-declared owners inside one grammar component and return score state to the same director; neither is a top-level planner.

authorityGroups.title: Owned performance-articulation resolvers
authorityGroups.limitations: Each resolver creates one typed articulation consumed by the canonical composition and renderer path.

authorityGroups.title: Canonical foundation-pitch owner
authorityGroups.limitations: The foundation resolver is the map-declared pitch owner and emits no PCM itself.

authorityGroups.title: Owned modal-percussion resolver
authorityGroups.limitations: It binds a physical-model intention inside the current instrument palette and cannot select another instrument engine.

authorityGroups.title: Owned long-horizon semantic resolvers
authorityGroups.limitations: These resolvers extend the one session plan and cannot commit a separate long-horizon runtime.

authorityGroups.title: Quality-recovery scheduling policy
authorityGroups.limitations: This contract schedules bounded recovery context; the installed primary evaluator and canonical preparer retain decision and render authority.

authorityGroups.title: Canonical phrase and voice render owners
authorityGroups.limitations: VoiceRenderer is the mapped voice stage called by the sole phrase renderer, not a separately dispatchable top-level renderer.

authorityGroups.title: Owned specialized render stages
authorityGroups.limitations: Both stages are called inside the sole phrase/voice render transaction and expose no host entry point.

authorityGroups.title: Canonical graph-plan and automatic-mix owners
authorityGroups.limitations: The graph generator selects the one graph plan; the balancer resolves bounded gains consumed inside the same voice render.

authorityGroups.title: Owned graph, evidence, and qualified-repeat stages
authorityGroups.limitations: These validators, analyzers, processors, and qualifiers are nested under one render/evaluation transaction and cannot schedule output.

authorityGroups.title: Owned DSP preparation transaction and commit gate
authorityGroups.limitations: Despite the similar name, AutonomousPhrasePreparer is the DSP transaction nested behind the platform-neutral AutonomousPerformancePreparer.

authorityGroups.title: Offline evidence-only evaluator
authorityGroups.limitations: This explicit offline collector always reports qualification unavailable and is never installed by either shipping host.

authorityGroups.title: Canonical primary quality evaluator
authorityGroups.limitations: Construction requires the exact installed profile, adversarial suite, holdout, engine, and evidence identities.

authorityGroups.title: Owned primary evidence, installation, and correction stages
authorityGroups.limitations: Analyzers create evidence, artifacts install one exact evaluator, and reducers propose bounded future corrections; none can accept or schedule PCM independently.

authorityGroups.title: Owned long-horizon policy and artifact stages
authorityGroups.limitations: The policy consumes reduced accepted evidence and can influence only an eligible future score through the mapped adaptation state.

authorityGroups.title: Canonical platform-neutral preparation owner
authorityGroups.limitations: Both hosts call this owner; it delegates one DSP transaction and returns one immutable PreparedPerformancePhrase.

authorityGroups.title: macOS transport owner
authorityGroups.limitations: TechnoEngine owns macOS scheduling and route lifecycle but receives its score and PCM from the shared preparer.

authorityGroups.title: macOS presentation-preparation adapter
authorityGroups.limitations: This private adapter adds immutable inspector snapshots only and cannot plan, render, evaluate, or replace PCM.

authorityGroups.title: Canonical live-feedback coordinator
authorityGroups.limitations: The coordinator observes authenticated app-owned PCM and can authorize only bounded future work.

authorityGroups.title: Owned live-feedback lifecycle and boundary stages
authorityGroups.limitations: These lifecycle objects authenticate, order, and expire work; they do not render PCM or choose musical content.

authorityGroups.title: Windows transport owner
authorityGroups.limitations: The Windows controller converts and queues the same prepared product; it is a host adapter rather than a second engine.

profileGroups.title: Score-owned groove profile
profileGroups.limitations: Profile means immutable groove data here, not a user-selectable or alternate runtime profile.

profileGroups.title: Qualified repeat-hold playback state
profileGroups.limitations: Mode is internal bounded presentation state, not a user mode, engine selector, or live effect path.

profileGroups.title: Live-feedback quiescence lifecycle state
profileGroups.limitations: Mode selects pause versus stop ordering during teardown and has no musical or renderer authority.

profileGroups.title: Bounded FDN DSP configuration
profileGroups.limitations: This is score-derived bounded DSP state inside the canonical voice renderer, not a preset or hidden graph.

profileGroups.title: Private modal-voice implementation configuration
profileGroups.limitations: Mode denotes one resonator coefficient record and is private to the canonical modal voice.

profileGroups.title: Score-owned material-world effect vocabulary
profileGroups.limitations: The historical identifier names a private bounded axis vocabulary, not factory presets, a browser, a selectable profile, or an alternate graph.

profileGroups.title: Installed long-horizon calibration profile
profileGroups.limitations: One exact packaged profile is fingerprint-bound to the current engine and primary policy; no selector is exposed.

profileGroups.title: Long-horizon adversarial and holdout support
profileGroups.limitations: These artifacts qualify the one installed profile and cannot be selected as runtime policies.

profileGroups.title: Installed primary calibration profile
profileGroups.limitations: Checkpoint profiles are parts of one exact installed calibration profile; neither is a runtime style or engine profile.

profileGroups.title: Primary adversarial and holdout support
profileGroups.limitations: These exact resources gate construction of the primary evaluator and expose no parallel runtime evaluator path.

effectPaths.title: Automatic mix planning inside voice rendering
effectPaths.limitations: The balancer emits bounded role gains consumed by VoiceRenderer; it has no output bus or host entry point.

effectPaths.title: Effect-carrier dose and upper-pump stage
effectPaths.limitations: This stage is score-bound around the one generated graph and rejoins the canonical phrase mix before terminal processing.

effectPaths.title: Prepared spatial feedback-delay network
effectPaths.limitations: The FDN is a prepared voice-local spatial primitive whose state is carried by the canonical RenderState.

effectPaths.title: Canonical generated DSP graph
effectPaths.limitations: This is the only score-generated graph plan/renderer path; specialized primitives remain subordinate stages.

effectPaths.title: Prequalified repeat-hold transformation branch
effectPaths.limitations: Branches are rendered and hard-gate-qualified during the same preparation transaction, remain bounded, and cannot advance canonical score state.

effectPaths.title: TPT antialiased nonlinear voice primitive
effectPaths.limitations: This voice-local filter/nonlinearity primitive is not a parallel graph or renderer and cannot dispatch itself.

effectPaths.title: Read-only waveform envelope projection
effectPaths.limitations: The envelope is derived after immutable PCM preparation for read-only presentation and cannot affect rendering or evidence.
